description.value: Orange Julius is a juice and fast food establishment offering takeaway service. The location provides a convenient stop for cyclists seeking quick refreshments while traveling through Fort St. John.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM confirms takeaway service (tag: takeaway=yes) for this juice-focused fast food location. However, the website prefetch was blocked by Cloudflare security verification and returned no usable website content, preventing verification of cyclist-specific amenities like bike parking or water refill. All contact details rely solely on OSM with no website corroboration possible due to the prefetch failure.
concerns: Website prefetch blocked by Cloudflare security verification; no website content available to verify amenities or contact details
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible fast food business with takeaway service. Lacking confirmed cyclist-specific amenities is not grounds for exclusion; any real, accessible business is useful to touring cyclists.
